entry.title: Isomorphic Labs Raises $5 Billion in Series C Funding Round
entry.content:
Links: techcrunch.com | isomorphiclabs.com

Isomorphic Labs has raised $5 billion in a Series C funding round co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital to advance its AI-driven drug discovery platform toward clinical trials. The financing follows a $2.1 billion Series B round in May and includes participation from Andreessen Horowitz alongside existing backers such as Alphabet's GV and Capital G, Thrive Capital, MGX, Temasek, and the UK Sovereign AI Fund.

The company builds upon the AlphaFold protein-folding breakthroughs developed at Google's DeepMind, which earned founder and CEO Demis Hassabis and John Jumper a Nobel Prize in chemistry. Isomorphic Labs has reported positive preclinical results in oncology and immunology and has established partnerships with major pharmaceutical firms including Eli Lilly, Novartis, and Johnson & Johnson.

entry.title: Science Corporation Raises $400 Million in Series D Funding at $3.5 Billion Valuation
entry.content:
Links: techcrunch.com | science.xyz

Science Corporation, a medical technology startup founded by former Neuralink president Max Hodak, has raised a $400 million Series D funding round that values the company at $3.5 billion. Investors in the round include Khosla Ventures, Tenet Healthcare, the Ackman Oxman Institute, and Y Combinator.

The company's flagship product is PRIMA, a wearable and implantable microchip that restores central vision in patients with age-related macular degeneration and is currently undergoing U.S. clinical trials for Stargardt's disease. Beyond vision restoration, Science Corporation is designing human trials for a bio-hybrid brain sensor aimed at treating neurological disorders such as Parkinson's disease.

entry.title: USD-Pegged Stablecoins Expand Across Latin America for Savings and Payments
entry.content:
Links: bloomberg.com

USD-pegged stablecoins are capturing an increasing share of cryptocurrency activity in Latin America, functioning both as a reliable store of value and an efficient mechanism for cross-border payments. These digital assets are utilized by individuals in countries like Argentina and Venezuela to protect savings against inflation, as well as by businesses in Mexico and Brazil for international transactions.

The adoption of stablecoins has accelerated even among users without prior blockchain knowledge, driven by local currency volatility and the demand for accessible digital dollars. This trend highlights the practical utility of cryptocurrency infrastructure in emerging markets beyond speculative trading.

entry.content:

The project introduces the city's own LVGA token alongside support for bitcoin and tether, allowing residents to use digital currencies for municipal services, taxes, and participating merchants.

Proponents argue that the partnership will attract tech companies, boost economic growth, and position the municipality at the forefront of financial innovation.
